name: Chat serving, 8 concurrent, ~1k in / 256 out
description: 200 chat requests with roughly 1k-token prompts and 256 output tokens at a concurrency of 8. The standard throughput point: run all three of c8, c32 and c64 to see where the engine stops scaling.
notes: Prompts are drawn from the m bucket (257-1024 approx tokens). Report the real input token count in metrics.input_tokens_total rather than assuming 1024.
